description: This file declares functions and macros for handling object IDs and hash conversions in a version control system, likely Git. It provides an interface for parsing hexadecimal hash strings, converting between binary hashes and hex representations, and supporting multiple hash algorithms.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Reads a hexadecimal representation of a hash from input and converts it into a binary object ID, using a specified hash algorithm.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop_r
methods.description: Converts a binary hash to its hexadecimal string representation using a specified hash algorithm, with static buffer support.

methods.name: oid_to_hex_r
methods.description: Converts an object ID to its hexadecimal string form, using a static buffer for the output.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Parses a hexadecimal hash string into a binary object ID, with support for different hash algorithms.
